source: The experts must produce compatible output shapes so their contributions can be combined. They can, in principle, have different internal architectures, but large language models commonly use homogeneous ZXNAME0000XZ experts because regularity simplifies training and execution.
zh: 专家们必须产生兼容的输出形状，以便将他们的贡献结合起来。原则上，它们可以具有不同的内部架构，但大型语言模型通常使用同质的 ZXNAME0000XZ 专家，因为规律性简化了训练和执行。
